=== Alert / loud ===
something went wrong and the reader must be interrupted: assertive, with the tone said in words as well as drawn in colour
<div role="alert"><div><span aria-hidden="true"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></span><p><span>Error: </span>Deploy failed</p></div><p>The build exited 1 after 42 seconds.</p><div><button type="button">View logs</button></div><a aria-label="Dismiss deploy failure" data-fui-push-state="/apps?dismiss=1" data-fui-rpc="/island/alerts?dismiss=1" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="alerts" href="/apps?dismiss=1">×</a></div>

=== Alert / quiet ===
the default: a standing message that is on screen anyway and must not interrupt whatever is being read
<div><div><p>3 apps need attention</p></div></div>

=== Alert / already there ===
the confirmation after a post-and-redirect — present at load, so the only reliable way to announce it is to put the reader on it
<div autofocus="" id="restarted" tabindex="-1"><div><p>App restarted</p></div></div>

=== Alert / with a body ===
the detail as markup: a persistent callout's contents are a list or a sample, and putting markup in the prose part would wrap it in a paragraph no validator allows
<div><div><p>Two apps need attention</p></div><div><ul><li>blog: disk at 91%</li><li>wiki: 4 restarts overnight</li></ul></div></div>

=== Alert / no headline ===
a message with no headline is still a message — the titleless shape is how a status line interrupts, and the refusal is saved for the box that says nothing at all
<div role="status"><div></div><p>Two apps need attention.</p></div>

=== BackToTop / to the page top ===
the anchor is a real same-origin link, so the no-script page jumps exactly where it says; the module only adds the threshold, the scroll and the focus return
<a aria-label="Back to top" data-hui-back-to-top="" href="#main-content"><span aria-hidden="true">↑</span><span>Back to top</span></a>

=== BackToTop / the default name ===
a jump control with no label of its own still names itself — the default word is the one Strings carries, and a translated page says it in the reader's language
<a aria-label="&lt;BackToTop&gt;" data-hui-back-to-top="" href="#top"><span aria-hidden="true">↑</span><span>&lt;BackToTop&gt;</span></a>

=== BackToTop / an explicit target and threshold ===
the target is an element id, never a selector — the module resolves it — and a threshold of zero would be the module's default, so an explicit one is the caller tuning when the link becomes true
<a aria-label="Back to contents" data-hui-back-to-top="" data-hui-back-to-top-smooth="" data-hui-back-to-top-target="toc" data-hui-back-to-top-threshold="480" href="#toc"><span aria-hidden="true">↑</span><span>Back to contents</span></a>

=== Badge / plain ===
a badge is a word, and the word is the accessible name — which is why the icon beside it is hidden rather than read twice
<span>running</span>

=== Badge / with an icon ===
the icon adds emphasis and no meaning: anything it means that the label does not say belongs in the label
<span><span aria-hidden="true"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></span>degraded</span>

=== Button / labelled ===
the ordinary case, and the reason type is always stated: inside a form the default is submit
<button type="button">Save changes</button>

=== Button / icon only ===
a button with no text still needs a name, or it cannot be operated by anyone who cannot see it
<button aria-label="Close" type="button"><span aria-hidden="true"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></span></button>

=== Button / link that looks like a button ===
it navigates, so it is an anchor — a button that changes the URL is a button a middle click cannot open
<a href="/docs">Read the docs</a>

=== Button / off-site link ===
a link that leaves the site opens a new tab and severs the opener — target=_blank without the noopener rel hands the destination a window handle back
<a href="https://example.com/docs" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Read the changelog</a>

=== Button / disabled link ===
a disabled anchor is not a thing in HTML, so the href goes and aria-disabled says why, rather than leaving a live link that looks dead
<a aria-disabled="true" role="link" tabindex="-1">Rollback</a>

=== Button / firing a request ===
the request a click makes is a prop on the button that fires it, in one reviewable place: the rpc triple lands through the Action seam and cannot arrive any other way, so a button that fires a request says so in its props
<button data-fui-rpc="/apps/api/restart" data-fui-rpc-method="POST" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" type="button">Restart api</button>

=== Button / mutating a local signal ===
a click that never leaves the browser is still what the button DOES, so it travels the same seam as a request: the mutation's attribute sits on the button beside its label, where a reviewer reads them together
<button data-fui-signal-inc="replicas" type="button">Add replica</button>

=== Card / titled ===
the common card: a heading, a line of context, a body
<div><div><h3>Deployments</h3><p>Last 24 hours</p></div><div><p>Nothing yet.</p></div></div>

=== Card / bare ===
no title and no description means no header — an empty header is a stripe of padding that reads as a mistake
<div><div><p>Body only.</p></div></div>

=== Card / footed ===
the footer is where the actions that apply to the whole card live
<div><div><h3>Restart policy</h3></div><div><p>On failure, up to 3 times.</p></div><div><button type="button">Save</button></div></div>

=== Card / the whole card is the link ===
an href on the card makes the surface itself the affordance — one focusable link wrapping what the div showed, so the click target is the card a reader can see rather than a Read more crammed into the footer
<a href="/apps/blog"><div><div><h3>blog</h3><p>2 vCPU, 4 GB</p></div><div><p>Deployed 3 days ago.</p></div></div></a>

=== Carousel / a carousel with every control ===
the track is a real scrollable list, the dots and arrows are fragment anchors to the slide ids, and the first slide is current — the whole thing works with no script
<div aria-label="Featured work" aria-roledescription="carousel" data-hui-carousel="" id="hui-carousel-d70082bc" role="region"><div><div data-hui-carousel-status="&lt;CarouselSlide 1 3&gt;" data-hui-carousel-status-fmt="&lt;CarouselSlide {n} {total}&gt;|3" data-hui-carousel-track="" id="hui-carousel-d70082bc-track" tabindex="0"><div aria-current="true" aria-label="&lt;CarouselSlide 1 3&gt;" aria-roledescription="slide" id="hui-carousel-d70082bc-track-slide-0" role="group">Slide one</div><div aria-label="&lt;CarouselSlide 2 3&gt;" aria-roledescription="slide" id="hui-carousel-d70082bc-track-slide-1" role="group">Slide two</div><div aria-label="&lt;CarouselSlide 3 3&gt;" aria-roledescription="slide" id="hui-carousel-d70082bc-track-slide-2" role="group">Slide three</div></div><a aria-label="&lt;Previous&gt;" data-hui-carousel-prev="" href="#hui-carousel-d70082bc-track-slide-0">&lt;Previous&gt;</a><a aria-label="&lt;Next&gt;" data-hui-carousel-next="" href="#hui-carousel-d70082bc-track-slide-2">&lt;Next&gt;</a></div><nav aria-label="Featured work"><a aria-current="true" aria-label="&lt;CarouselGoTo 1&gt;" data-hui-carousel-goto="0" href="#hui-carousel-d70082bc-track-slide-0">1</a><a aria-label="&lt;CarouselGoTo 2&gt;" data-hui-carousel-goto="1" href="#hui-carousel-d70082bc-track-slide-1">2</a><a aria-label="&lt;CarouselGoTo 3&gt;" data-hui-carousel-goto="2" href="#hui-carousel-d70082bc-track-slide-2">3</a></nav></div>

=== Carousel / bare, rotating and looping ===
without dots or arrows the track and the status are the whole contract, and the rotation flags ride the root for the module to pause on hover, focus, hidden and reduced motion
<div aria-label="Hero" aria-roledescription="carousel" data-hui-carousel="" data-hui-carousel-loop="" data-hui-carousel-rotate-ms="6000" id="hui-carousel-9b67a879" role="region"><div><div data-hui-carousel-status="&lt;CarouselSlide 1 1&gt;" data-hui-carousel-status-fmt="&lt;CarouselSlide {n} {total}&gt;|1" data-hui-carousel-track="" id="hui-carousel-9b67a879-track" tabindex="0"><div aria-current="true" aria-label="&lt;CarouselSlide 1 1&gt;" aria-roledescription="slide" id="hui-carousel-9b67a879-track-slide-0" role="group">Only</div></div></div></div>

=== Choice / checkbox with a hint ===
the label WRAPS the control, so the hit area is the whole row and there is no for/id pair left to go stale
<label><input name="prune" type="checkbox" value="1"><span>Prune old images<span>Keeps the last three builds.</span></span></label>

=== Choice / radio ===
a real radio, so one arrow key moves through the set and the browser enforces that exactly one is chosen
<label><input name="policy" type="radio" value="always"><span>Always</span></label>

=== Cluster / default ===
a row of controls is what the component is for, and it wraps by default — a row that cannot wrap is a row that overflows a phone
<div><button type="button">Restart</button><button type="button">Stop</button><button type="button">View logs</button></div>

=== Cluster / gap and alignment ===
controls of different heights meet on their middles: the gap is a step on the same scale every other primitive uses and the alignment is named on its own axis
<div><button type="button">Save</button><button aria-label="Deployment settings" type="button"><span aria-hidden="true"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></span></button><button type="button">Cancel</button></div>

=== Cluster / space between ===
justify-between puts the destructive action at the far end from the safe one — the space is the skin's, not a spacer element somebody wedged between them
<div><button type="button">Save</button><button type="button">Delete app</button></div>

=== Color / swatch ===
a colour input is useless alone to anyone who cannot see it, so the hex value stays beside it as text that can be read and typed — inside a Field, so the value is a labelled setting and not a bare control
<div><label for="color-accent">Accent colour</label><div data-hui-affix="" data-hui-color=""><input aria-label="&lt;PickColor accent&gt;" data-hui-affix-swatch="" id="color-accent-picker" tabindex="-1" type="color" value="#10b981"><input autocapitalize="off" autocomplete="off" data-hui-affix-input="" id="color-accent" name="accent" spellcheck="false" type="text" value="#10b981"></div></div>

=== Combobox / a static combobox ===
the options are real content the server rendered, the input owns the keyboard, and no script is needed to read the list
<div data-hui-combobox=""><label for="q">Search</label><div><input aria-autocomplete="list" aria-controls="q-listbox" aria-expanded="false" autocomplete="off" data-hui-combobox-input="" id="q" name="q" role="combobox" spellcheck="false" type="text"></div><ul aria-label="Search &lt;ComboboxResultsLabel&gt;" data-hui-combobox-count="&lt;ComboboxResultCount {n}&gt;" data-hui-combobox-listbox="" data-hui-combobox-static="" hidden="" id="q-listbox" role="listbox"><li data-value="Docs" id="q-listbox-opt-0" role="option"><span>Docs</span><span>/docs</span></li><li data-fui-push-state="/examples" data-value="Examples" id="q-listbox-opt-1" role="option"><span>Examples</span></li></ul><span data-hui-combobox-no-results="&lt;ComboboxNoResults&gt;" data-hui-combobox-status="" role="status"></span></div>

=== Combobox / an island combobox ===
the results region is bound to the island's signal, and the no-script path is the same-origin GET form wrapping the whole combobox
<form action="/search" method="GET" role="none"><div data-hui-combobox=""><label for="site-q">Search</label><div data-fui-rpc="/island/search" data-fui-rpc-debounce-ms="250" data-fui-rpc-method="POST" data-fui-rpc-signal="search" data-fui-rpc-trigger="input" data-hui-combobox-loader="" data-hui-combobox-loading="&lt;ComboboxLoading&gt;"><input aria-autocomplete="list" aria-controls="site-q-listbox" aria-expanded="false" autocomplete="off" data-hui-combobox-input="" id="site-q" name="q" role="combobox" spellcheck="false" type="text"></div><ul aria-label="Search &lt;ComboboxResultsLabel&gt;" data-fui-signal="search" data-fui-signal-mode="html" data-hui-combobox-count="&lt;ComboboxResultCount {n}&gt;" data-hui-combobox-listbox="" hidden="" id="site-q-listbox" role="listbox"></ul><span data-hui-combobox-no-results="&lt;ComboboxNoResults&gt;" data-hui-combobox-status="" role="status"></span></div></form>

=== ConditionalField / shown when the watched field matches ===
rendered visible with no hidden attribute, because a field only script can reveal is a field a scriptless reader never reaches — the runtime hides it when the watched field does not match, and not before
<label><input name="notify" type="radio" value="webhook"><span>Webhook</span></label><div data-hui-when="notify" data-hui-when-value="webhook"><div><label for="cond-webhook-url">Webhook URL</label><input id="cond-webhook-url" name="webhook-url" type="text"></div></div>

=== Container / reading measure ===
the default is the measure a page of prose reads at — line length is readability, decided here once so no page has to remember to ask for it
<div><p>One leader runs the cluster and any number of workers join it.</p></div>

=== Container / small ===
a focused task wants a short measure — a sign-in card, one setting — where a full-width line would wander
<div><p>Sign in to continue.</p></div>

=== Container / medium ===
a settings form sits between prose and dashboard: wide enough for label and field beside each other, narrow enough that the eye keeps the line
<div><p>HTTP port 80, HTTPS port 443.</p></div>

=== Container / large ===
the widest bounded measure — wide content such as a table of apps, still stopped somewhere so a line cannot run the width of the screen
<div><p>Eleven apps across three workers.</p></div>

=== Container / full ===
full drops the maximum and keeps the gutter — a dashboard should use the whole screen, and the gutter is the one thing it may not lose, because the edge of a phone is where text stops being readable
<div><p>CPU, memory and network for every node.</p></div>

=== Counter / a signal counter ===
the value is on the page before any script runs and the buttons speak the kernel's increment contract — the counter works with no module of this package loaded at all
<div aria-label="Quantity" role="group"><button aria-label="&lt;CounterDecrement&gt;" data-fui-signal-inc="qty:-1" type="button">−</button><span aria-live="polite" data-fui-signal="qty">2</span><button aria-label="&lt;CounterIncrement&gt;" data-fui-signal-inc="qty" type="button">+</button></div>

=== Counter / animated ===
the final value is the SSR text, so a reader without script sees the true count while the animation is only presentation, and reduced motion keeps the number
<div aria-label="Deployed" data-hui-counter-animate="" data-hui-counter-from="0" data-hui-counter-ms="600" role="group"><button aria-label="&lt;CounterDecrement&gt;" data-fui-signal-inc="deployed:-1" type="button">−</button><span aria-live="polite" data-fui-signal="deployed">4820</span><button aria-label="&lt;CounterIncrement&gt;" data-fui-signal-inc="deployed" type="button">+</button></div>

=== Counter / the unlabelled group names itself ===
a counter with no label of its own still names its group — the default word is the one Strings carries, so a translated page says it in the reader's language
<div aria-label="&lt;CounterLabel&gt;" role="group"><button aria-label="&lt;CounterDecrement&gt;" data-fui-signal-inc="hits:-1" type="button">−</button><span aria-live="polite" data-fui-signal="hits">7</span><button aria-label="&lt;CounterIncrement&gt;" data-fui-signal-inc="hits" type="button">+</button></div>

=== Counter / named, for a form ===
a named number input submits without script, and the signal writes its value attribute so the display and the submitted field are one number
<div aria-label="Seats" role="group"><button aria-label="&lt;CounterDecrement&gt;" data-fui-signal-inc="seats:-1" type="button">−</button><input aria-label="Seats" data-fui-signal="seats" data-fui-signal-attr="value" name="seats" step="1" type="number" value="4"><button aria-label="&lt;CounterIncrement&gt;" data-fui-signal-inc="seats" type="button">+</button></div>

=== DetailList / a record ===
a dt and the dd after it are one pair to assistive technology in a way a grid of divs never is, and the pair survives every restyling because the relationship is the element
<dl><div><dt>Name</dt><dd>blog</dd></div><div><dt>Status</dt><dd><span>running</span></dd></div><div><dt>Restarts</dt><dd>263</dd></div></dl>

=== Disclosure / a closed disclosure ===
the summary is a real controller and the panel is real content with no script — the module only keeps the accessibility state the platform leaves missing
<details data-hui-disclosure=""><summary>What is this?</summary><div>A native details element.</div></details>

=== Disclosure / open, and persistent ===
an open state a navigation keeps is opt-in: the persist key names the store the module restores from, so a shell's section survives a client-side page turn
<details data-hui-disclosure="" data-hui-disclosure-persist="list.filters" open=""><summary>Filters</summary><div>Persistent across navigation.</div></details>

=== Disclosure / the trap posture ===
a disclosure used as a drawer contains focus while open — Tab walks inside it — through the widget runtime's containment, released on close and on detach
<details data-hui-disclosure="" data-hui-disclosure-trap=""><summary>Menu</summary><div>A drawer-shaped disclosure.</div></details>

=== Disclosure / an exclusive group ===
two disclosures sharing a name open one at a time in the browser itself — the native accordion, no script on the page at all
<details data-hui-disclosure="" name="faq"><summary>First question</summary><div>One answer.</div></details><details data-hui-disclosure="" name="faq"><summary>Second question</summary><div>Another answer.</div></details>

=== Divider / horizontal ===
the default is a real hr: a break between two groups of content means separator, and the element already says it, so no role is claimed
<hr>

=== Divider / vertical ===
inside a row the break runs along the block axis, and aria-orientation says so — a vertical rule drawn as a bare line says nothing about which way the groups sit
<hr aria-orientation="vertical">

=== Divider / labelled ===
a label cannot live in an hr — it has no content model — so the separator role is claimed on the div that replaces it and the lines around the words are hidden
<div role="separator"><span aria-hidden="true"></span><span>or</span><span aria-hidden="true"></span></div>

=== EmptyState / nothing here yet ===
the region is named by its own heading, so a reader who lands on it is told what is absent and offered the way out — a dead end with no action is a page the back button owns
<div aria-label="No apps yet" role="region"><h3>No apps yet</h3><p>Deploy your first app and it will appear here.</p><div><button type="button">New app</button></div></div>

=== EmptyState / an empty result ===
a search that matched nothing names the absence after itself; with no explicit ID the name is an aria-label, so two panels that share a title share no id
<div aria-label="No apps match" role="region"><h2>No apps match</h2><p>Clear a filter or try another name.</p></div>

=== Field / hinted ===
the hint is tied to the control by id, or it is on screen for sighted users only and the format rule never arrives
<div><label for="field-port">Port</label><input aria-describedby="field-port-hint" id="field-port" name="field-port" type="text"><p id="field-port-hint">1–65535</p></div>

=== Field / errored ===
the error JOINS the hint in the description, ahead of it: the hint is the rule the value must obey and the error is the violation, so dropping the rule exactly when it was broken is dropping it when it is needed most — and the correction is read first because it comes first
<div><label for="field-port-bad">Port</label><input aria-describedby="field-port-bad-error field-port-bad-hint" aria-invalid="true" id="field-port-bad" name="field-port-bad" type="text"><p id="field-port-bad-error" role="alert">Already in use.</p><p id="field-port-bad-hint">1–65535</p></div>

=== Field / reserved error node ===
a script that fills the error without re-rendering needs the node and its id already in the description — an empty described-by target announces nothing until it is filled, which is the point, and the stylesheet keeps the empty node out of the layout
<div><label for="field-token-live">Token</label><input aria-describedby="field-token-live-error" id="field-token-live" name="field-token-live" type="text"><p id="field-token-live-error" role="alert"></p></div>

=== Field / required ===
required is a state the parser is told about, not a red asterisk — which is a picture of a rule
<div><label data-required="" for="app">App name</label><input id="app" name="app" required="" type="text"></div>

=== FieldRow / pair ===
two fields side by side are still two fields: the row adds layout and no semantics, so nothing here is announced
<div><div><label for="from">From</label><input id="from" name="from" type="text"></div><div><label for="to">To</label><input id="to" name="to" type="text"></div></div>

=== Fieldset / a titled group ===
a real legend in a real fieldset names every control inside without a single aria attribute — the native group semantic a wrapper div has to fake with labels nobody checks
<fieldset aria-describedby="fieldset-notifications-desc"><legend>Notifications</legend><p id="fieldset-notifications-desc">How this app tells you about deploys.</p><div><div><label for="deploy-email">Deploy email</label><input id="deploy-email" name="deploy-email" type="text"></div><div><label for="failure-email">Failure email</label><input id="failure-email" name="failure-email" type="text"></div></div></fieldset>

=== Fieldset / a group error ===
the error that belongs to the group as a whole is wired by aria-describedby on the group, so it is read with the question and never replaces a field's own error
<fieldset aria-describedby="fieldset-access-error"><legend>Access</legend><p id="fieldset-access-error">Pick at least one role.</p><div><div><label for="role-admin">Admin</label><input id="role-admin" name="role-admin" type="text"></div></div></fieldset>

=== Fieldset / no title ===
a group with no name renders as a plain div: an unlabelled fieldset is a landmark that names nothing, and a screen reader announcing an empty group label is the alternative
<div aria-describedby="misc-desc" id="misc"><p id="misc-desc">The remaining settings.</p><div><div><label for="retries">Retries</label><input id="retries" name="retries" type="text"></div></div></div>

=== FileUpload / with a hint ===
the zone is a label around a real input, so the whole target opens the picker — and the call to action is styled text, because a button inside a label swallows the label's click
<div data-hui-drop="" data-hui-drop-input="backup" data-hui-drop-many="&lt;FilesSelected {n} {names}&gt;" data-hui-drop-one="&lt;FileSelected {name}&gt;"><label for="backup"><span>Drag an archive here, or </span><span>choose a file</span><span id="backup-accept">.tar.gz up to 2 GB</span></label><input accept=".tar.gz" aria-describedby="backup-accept" id="backup" name="backup" type="file"><ul data-hui-drop-list="" role="list"></ul><span data-hui-drop-status="" role="status"></span></div>

=== Form / a create form ===
the fields land in the body and the submits in the actions row, and the method defaults to post so a create never rides a GET a browser may repeat on its own
<form action="/apps" aria-label="Create an app" method="post"><div><div><label for="new-app-name">App name</label><input id="new-app-name" name="app-name" type="text"></div></div><div><button type="submit">Create app</button></div></form>

=== Form / after a failed submit ===
errors set the hook that moves focus to the summary, so a screen reader hears what went wrong instead of sitting on an unchanged-looking page
<form action="/apps" data-hui-form-errors="" method="post" novalidate=""><div aria-labelledby="form-dup-errors-title" id="form-dup-errors" role="alert" tabindex="-1"><h2 id="form-dup-errors-title">&lt;ThereIsAProblem&gt;</h2><ul><li><a href="#dup-app-name">That name is taken.</a></li></ul></div><div><div><label for="dup-app-name">App name</label><input aria-describedby="dup-app-name-error" aria-invalid="true" id="dup-app-name" name="app-name" type="text"><p id="dup-app-name-error" role="alert">That name is taken.</p></div></div><div><button type="submit">Create app</button></div></form>

=== Form / with a file upload ===
multipart sets the encoding a file input needs, because without it the browser submits the file's name and no contents, which looks like a server bug and is not one
<form action="/apps/definition" enctype="multipart/form-data" method="post"><div><div data-hui-drop="" data-hui-drop-input="definition-file" data-hui-drop-many="&lt;FilesSelected {n} {names}&gt;" data-hui-drop-one="&lt;FileSelected {name}&gt;"><label for="definition-file"><span>Captain definition</span><span>Choose a file</span></label><input id="definition-file" name="definition" type="file"><ul data-hui-drop-list="" role="list"></ul><span data-hui-drop-status="" role="status"></span></div></div><div><button type="submit">Upload</button></div></form>

=== Gallery / a gallery with captions ===
every item is a real link to the full image, so the gallery works with no script at all
<ul aria-label="Screenshots"><li><figure><a href="/one.png"><img alt="The dashboard" height="150" src="/one.png" width="200"></a><figcaption>Overview</figcaption></figure></li><li><a href="/two.png"><img alt="The settings" height="150" src="/two-thumb.png" width="200"></a></li></ul>

=== Gallery / a gallery with per-item hrefs ===
a caller's href replaces the full-image fallback per item, and an unsafe one degrades instead of shipping
<ul aria-label="Photos"><li><a href="/detail/one"><img alt="One" height="150" src="/one.png" width="200"></a></li><li><a href="#"><img alt="Two" height="150" src="/two.png" width="200"></a></li></ul>

=== Grid / minimum column and gap ===
Min is a floor — a column never gets narrower than the named step before the grid gives one up — and the name is what keeps the floor wired: the framework's Grid took a free-form Min that nothing read, so every auto-fit grid was the default width whatever its author asked
<div><p>blog — 2 vCPU</p><p>wiki — 1 vCPU</p><p>api — 4 vCPU</p></div>

=== Group / radio set ===
the legend is the question the choices answer — without it a screen reader reads three labels and never says what is being decided
<fieldset><legend>Restart policy</legend><label><input name="policy" type="radio" value="always"><span>Always</span></label><label><input name="policy" type="radio" value="failure"><span>On failure</span></label></fieldset>

=== Group / required set ===
the cue and the rule are two different things: data-required on the legend is what a sighted reader looks for, and the required attribute on a leaf is what the browser enforces — a group carrying only one of them is a group that either lies or looks optional
<fieldset><legend data-required="">Plan</legend><label><input name="plan" required="" type="radio" value="free"><span>Free</span></label><label><input name="plan" type="radio" value="pro"><span>Pro</span></label></fieldset>

=== Input / described ===
the description it is handed is written out: six of the eight text controls once accepted DescribedBy and dropped it, so the field wired a relationship to an attribute nobody rendered — here the control sits in a Field the way a page would use it, and the hint arrives through that relationship
<div><label for="input-port">Port</label><input aria-describedby="input-port-hint" id="input-port" name="port" type="text" value="8080"><p id="input-port-hint">1–65535</p></div>

=== Input / invalid ===
aria-invalid is the state; the red border is the picture of it
<div><label for="input-port-bad">Port</label><input aria-describedby="input-port-bad-error" aria-invalid="true" id="input-port-bad" name="port" type="text"><p id="input-port-bad-error" role="alert">Already in use.</p></div>

=== InputGroup / an input with a button ===
with no label the group is a plain div, because wrapping labelled controls in a group with a third name makes a screen reader read the group name before each one
<div><div><label for="jump-app">Jump to app</label><input id="jump-app" name="app" type="text" value="registry app"><p id="jump-app-hint">Jump to an app in this cluster.</p></div><button type="submit">Go</button></div>

=== InputGroup / two focusable things ===
a group holding more than one focusable control takes a role and a name, so it appears in the landmark list as one identifiable control
<div aria-label="Webhook URL and port" role="group"><div><label for="hook-host">Host</label><input id="hook-host" name="host" type="text" value="app.example.com"></div><div><label for="hook-port">Port</label><input id="hook-port" name="port" type="text" value="30000"></div></div>

=== JSONTree / an object tree ===
every collection is a native details, so the tree collapses and expands with no script
<div><details open=""><summary><span>&lt;JSONObject&gt;</span><span>(3)</span></summary><ul><li><span>&quot;meta&quot;</span><span>:</span><details><summary><span>&lt;JSONObject&gt;</span><span>(1)</span></summary><ul><li><span>&quot;stars&quot;</span><span>:</span><span>42</span></li></ul></details></li><li><span>&quot;name&quot;</span><span>:</span><span>&quot;gofastr&quot;</span></li><li><span>&quot;tags&quot;</span><span>:</span><details><summary><span>&lt;JSONArray&gt;</span><span>(2)</span></summary><ol><li><span>0</span><span>:</span><span>&quot;fast&quot;</span></li><li><span>1</span><span>:</span><span>&quot;ssr&quot;</span></li></ol></details></li></ul></details></div>

=== JSONTree / the scalar and empty words ===
an empty collection renders its word, not a details with nothing under it, and the null/boolean literals are words a translation owns
<div><details open=""><summary><span>&lt;JSONObject&gt;</span><span>(6)</span></summary><ul><li><span>&quot;emptyList&quot;</span><span>:</span><span>&lt;JSONEmptyArray&gt;</span></li><li><span>&quot;emptyMap&quot;</span><span>:</span><span>&lt;JSONEmptyObject {}&gt;</span></li><li><span>&quot;long&quot;</span><span>:</span><span>&quot;a string&lt;JSONTruncated&gt;&quot;</span></li><li><span>&quot;nothing&quot;</span><span>:</span><span>&lt;JSONNull&gt;</span></li><li><span>&quot;off&quot;</span><span>:</span><span>&lt;JSONFalse&gt;</span></li><li><span>&quot;on&quot;</span><span>:</span><span>&lt;JSONTrue&gt;</span></li></ul></details></div>

=== LightboxViewer / full ===
the working end of a gallery: nav, caption and download all on, so every hook, binding and button a module or a signal could lose is on the page
<div data-hui-lightbox="photos" data-hui-lightbox-nav="true"><figure><span data-fui-signal="alt" data-fui-signal-mode="text" id="photos-title">&lt;LightboxViewerLabel&gt;</span><img data-fui-signal="src" data-fui-signal-attr="src" data-fui-signal-mode="attr" data-hui-lightbox-image=""><figcaption data-fui-signal="caption" data-fui-signal-mode="text"></figcaption></figure><div><button aria-label="&lt;LightboxPrevious&gt;" data-hui-lightbox-prev="photos" type="button"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></button><button aria-label="&lt;LightboxNext&gt;" data-hui-lightbox-next="photos" type="button"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></button><a aria-label="&lt;LightboxDownload&gt;" data-fui-signal="src" data-fui-signal-attr="href" data-fui-signal-mode="attr" download=""><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></a></div></div>

=== LightboxViewer / bare ===
the minimum a viewer is: a named image and its accessible name, nothing optional — a markdown figure or a single inline photo needs no nav and saves the buttons
<div data-hui-lightbox="figure"><figure><span data-fui-signal="alt" data-fui-signal-mode="text" id="figure-title">&lt;LightboxViewerLabel&gt;</span><img data-fui-signal="src" data-fui-signal-attr="src" data-fui-signal-mode="attr" data-hui-lightbox-image=""></figure></div>

=== LightboxViewer / framework wiring ===
the binder's spellings instead of the hooks: the same identity, nav opt-in, buttons and zoom target as data-fui-lightbox*, for the framework module a styled lightbox ships — the hui twins are suppressed here; they render exactly when the host's own module is the intended binder
<div data-fui-lightbox="photos" data-fui-lightbox-nav="true"><figure><span data-fui-signal="alt" data-fui-signal-mode="text" id="photos-title">&lt;LightboxViewerLabel&gt;</span><img data-fui-lightbox-image="" data-fui-signal="src" data-fui-signal-attr="src" data-fui-signal-mode="attr"></figure><div><button aria-label="&lt;LightboxPrevious&gt;" data-fui-lightbox-prev="photos" type="button"></button><button aria-label="&lt;LightboxNext&gt;" data-fui-lightbox-next="photos" type="button"></button><a aria-label="&lt;LightboxDownload&gt;" data-fui-signal="src" data-fui-signal-attr="href" data-fui-signal-mode="attr" download=""></a></div></div>

=== Menu / a summary menu ===
the summary is a real controller and every row is a real command with no script; the module adds the keyboard contract on top
<details data-hui-disclosure="" data-hui-menu="hui-menu-51114016"><summary aria-controls="hui-menu-51114016-panel" aria-haspopup="menu">Account<span aria-hidden="true">▾</span></summary><div data-hui-menu-panel="" id="hui-menu-51114016-panel" role="menu"><a href="/me" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1"><span>Profile</span></a><hr role="separator"><button data-fui-rpc="/api/del" data-fui-rpc-method="DELETE" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1" type="button"><span>Delete</span></button></div></details>

=== Menu / a submenu ===
the nested panel is the same disclosure machinery at depth, so Escape walks back one level and the parent row is the controller
<details data-hui-disclosure="" data-hui-menu="hui-menu-02743c3c"><summary aria-controls="hui-menu-02743c3c-panel" aria-haspopup="menu">Theme<span aria-hidden="true">▾</span></summary><div data-hui-menu-panel="" id="hui-menu-02743c3c-panel" role="menu"><details data-hui-disclosure="" data-hui-menu="hui-menu-02743c3c-panel-sub-0"><summary aria-controls="hui-menu-02743c3c-panel-sub-0-panel" aria-haspopup="menu" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1"><span>Palette</span></summary><div data-hui-menu-panel="" id="hui-menu-02743c3c-panel-sub-0-panel" role="menu"><button aria-checked="false" data-hui-menu-radio="theme" role="menuitemradio" tabindex="-1" type="button"><span>Light</span></button><button aria-checked="true" data-hui-menu-radio="theme" role="menuitemradio" tabindex="-1" type="button"><span>Dark</span></button></div></details><button role="menuitem" tabindex="-1" type="button"><span>Reset</span></button></div></details>

=== Menu / a caller-owned trigger ===
the caller's element sits beside a summary-less disclosure it controls — an interactive element inside a summary is axe nested-interactive
<div><div data-hui-menu-trigger="hui-menu-8303815e" role="presentation"><button type="button">Open user menu</button></div><details data-hui-disclosure="" data-hui-menu="hui-menu-8303815e"><div data-hui-menu-panel="" id="hui-menu-8303815e-panel" role="menu"><a href="/me" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1"><span>Profile</span></a></div></details></div>

=== Menu / a disabled row and a separator ===
the disabled row keeps its place in the panel and leaves the keyboard rotation; the separator divides groups without joining them
<details data-hui-disclosure="" data-hui-menu="hui-menu-aabcd531"><summary aria-controls="hui-menu-aabcd531-panel" aria-haspopup="menu">View<span aria-hidden="true">▾</span></summary><div data-hui-menu-panel="" id="hui-menu-aabcd531-panel" role="menu"><button role="menuitem" tabindex="-1" type="button"><span>Compact</span></button><hr role="separator"><button aria-disabled="true" disabled="" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1" type="button"><span>Experimental</span></button></div></details>

=== Menu / rows with an icon and a form action, lazy-mounted ===
an icon row and a form-POST row are commands like any other, and a lazy panel's rows travel inside a template the module mounts on first open — page-scoped queries cannot see them while the menu is closed
<details data-hui-disclosure="" data-hui-menu="hui-menu-07666dff"><summary aria-controls="hui-menu-07666dff-panel" aria-haspopup="menu">Account<span aria-hidden="true">▾</span></summary><div data-hui-menu-panel="" id="hui-menu-07666dff-panel" role="menu"><template data-hui-menu-lazy=""><a href="/w" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1"><span aria-hidden="true"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></span><span>Open workspace</span></a><hr role="separator"><form action="/admin/stop-impersonation" method="POST" role="none"><input name="csrf" type="hidden" value="tok"><button role="menuitem" tabindex="-1" type="submit"><span>Stop impersonation</span></button></form></template></div></details>

=== NotificationBell / unread ===
the anchor's accessible name says the count in words while the badge shows the number, and the href is the notifications page — the no-script page goes there
<a aria-label="&lt;NotificationCount 3&gt;" data-hui-notification-bell="" data-hui-notification-count-fmt="&lt;NotificationCount %d&gt;" href="/notifications"><span aria-hidden="true">🔔</span><span data-hui-notification-count="3"><span>3</span></span></a>

=== NotificationBell / a widget trigger ===
Opens names the widget the same anchor opens with script: one element is the no-script link and the trigger, through the kernel's own data-fui-open spelling typed from a prop
<a aria-label="&lt;NotificationCount 1&gt;" data-fui-open="bell-panel" data-fui-popover-anchor="bottom" data-hui-notification-bell="" data-hui-notification-count-fmt="&lt;NotificationCount %d&gt;" href="/notifications"><span aria-hidden="true">🔔</span><span data-hui-notification-count="1"><span>1</span></span></a>

=== NotificationBell / nothing unread, the count live ===
zero renders no badge (no news is no news) and the signal-bound count raises it the moment news arrives, without a re-render
<a aria-label="&lt;NotificationCount 0&gt;" data-hui-notification-bell="" data-hui-notification-count-fmt="&lt;NotificationCount %d&gt;" href="/notifications"><span aria-hidden="true">🔔</span><span data-fui-signal="unread" data-fui-signal-mode="text" data-hui-notification-count="0"><span>0</span></span></a>

=== NumberInput / unbounded, with help ===
a real, named number input works with no script at all, and the rule it obeys rides its description — the buttons are enhancement only
<div aria-label="Port" role="group"><label for="port">Port</label><div><button aria-label="&lt;NumberDecrement Port&gt;" data-hui-number-input-decrement="" data-hui-number-input-for="port" type="button">−</button><input aria-describedby="port-hint" id="port" name="port" step="1" type="number" value="8080"><button aria-label="&lt;NumberIncrement Port&gt;" data-hui-number-input-for="port" data-hui-number-input-increment="" type="button">+</button></div><p id="port-hint">1024 to 65535</p></div>

=== NumberInput / bounded at both edges ===
the bounds are on the input (the browser enforces them for typing) and the buttons' names say which field they step — the hook the module resolves the input by rides each button
<div aria-label="Replicas" role="group"><label for="replicas">Replicas</label><div><button aria-label="&lt;NumberDecrement Replicas&gt;" data-hui-number-input-decrement="" data-hui-number-input-for="replicas" type="button">−</button><input id="replicas" max="10" min="1" name="replicas" step="1" type="number" value="3"><button aria-label="&lt;NumberIncrement Replicas&gt;" data-hui-number-input-for="replicas" data-hui-number-input-increment="" type="button">+</button></div></div>

=== NumberInput / disabled with an error ===
disabled takes the buttons out with the input, and the violation is read before the rule because the correction arrives before the reminder
<div aria-label="Quota" role="group"><label for="quota">Quota</label><div><button aria-label="&lt;NumberDecrement Quota&gt;" data-hui-number-input-decrement="" data-hui-number-input-for="quota" disabled="" type="button">−</button><input aria-describedby="quota-error" aria-invalid="true" disabled="" id="quota" max="10" min="1" name="quota" step="1" type="number" value="2"><button aria-label="&lt;NumberIncrement Quota&gt;" data-hui-number-input-for="quota" data-hui-number-input-increment="" disabled="" type="button">+</button></div><p id="quota-error" role="alert">Below the minimum</p></div>

=== OptimisticAction / default ===
both labels ship in the SSR so the optimistic flip needs no round-trip, the method is absent because POST is the runtime's default, and the status span exists because the framework's shake announces nothing
<button data-hui-action="" data-hui-action-endpoint="/apps/blog/restart" data-hui-action-failed="&lt;ActionFailed&gt;" data-state="idle" type="button"><span data-hui-action-idle="">Restart now</span><span data-hui-action-done="" hidden="">Restarting</span><span data-hui-action-status="" role="status"></span></button>

=== OptimisticAction / with icons ===
each label carries its own icon so the flip swaps glyph and word together, and both are aria-hidden because the words are the meaning — a check mark nobody can hear says nothing
<button data-hui-action="" data-hui-action-endpoint="/apps/blog/pin" data-hui-action-failed="&lt;ActionFailed&gt;" data-state="idle" type="button"><span data-hui-action-idle=""><span aria-hidden="true"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></span>Pin</span><span data-hui-action-done="" hidden=""><span aria-hidden="true"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></span>Pinned</span><span data-hui-action-status="" role="status"></span></button>

=== OptimisticAction / delete, not post ===
a method other than POST is published as an attribute, because the runtime defaults to POST and an unstated DELETE would fire the wrong request entirely
<button data-hui-action="" data-hui-action-endpoint="/webhooks/9" data-hui-action-failed="&lt;ActionFailed&gt;" data-hui-action-method="DELETE" data-state="idle" type="button"><span data-hui-action-idle="">Remove webhook</span><span data-hui-action-done="" hidden="">Removed</span><span data-hui-action-status="" role="status"></span></button>

=== OptimisticAction / disabled ===
a disabled optimistic button still ships both labels and its announcement hook — disabling is a state of the click, not of the contract, and the runtime re-enables the button itself while a mutation is in flight
<button data-hui-action="" data-hui-action-endpoint="/apps/blog/redeploy" data-hui-action-failed="&lt;ActionFailed&gt;" data-state="idle" disabled="" type="button"><span data-hui-action-idle="">Redeploy</span><span data-hui-action-done="" hidden="">Redeploying</span><span data-hui-action-status="" role="status"></span></button>

=== PageHeader / page top ===
the title is the page's h1 and the actions beside it are the page's own — a reader who lands mid-scroll jumps here to learn where they are
<header><div><h1>Apps</h1><p>Eleven apps across three workers.</p></div><div><button type="button">New app</button></div></header>

=== PageHeader / eyebrow ===
a kicker above the title is hidden from the tree: it repeats what the title or the navigation already says, and hearing the page's name twice is the alternative
<header><div><p aria-hidden="true">Customers</p><h1>Northwind Traders</h1></div></header>

=== PageHeader / deeper in the outline ===
a header for a sub-page inside a page claims level 2 rather than a second h1 — the outline is how a screen reader user moves, and two h1s on one page is a hole in it
<header><div><h2>Deployment history</h2></div></header>

=== Pagination / plain, on a list screen ===
the URL is the truth for a list and a pager on it is list state: the page anchors are plain navigations the client router intercepts, and no data-hui-page renders without an Island — a hook nothing reads is markup carried for no one
<nav aria-label="Application pages, plain"><div><a href="/apps?p=1">&lt;Previous&gt;</a><a href="/apps?p=1">1</a><a aria-current="page" href="/apps?p=2">2</a><a href="/apps?p=3">3</a><a href="/apps?p=3">&lt;Next&gt;</a></div></nav>

=== Pagination / middle of a long run, an island pager ===
the gap is a span and not a link, the current page says aria-current=page rather than being told apart by weight, and an embedded pager's anchors carry the RPC contract beside their hrefs — the page without script, the region update with it — plus the data-hui-page the module restores focus through
<nav aria-label="Application pages, middle"><div><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=4" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=4" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="4" href="/apps?p=4">&lt;Previous&gt;</a><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=1" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=1" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="1" href="/apps?p=1">1</a><span aria-hidden="true">…</span><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=4" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=4" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="4" href="/apps?p=4">4</a><a aria-current="page" data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=5" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=5" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="5" href="/apps?p=5">5</a><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=6" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=6" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="6" href="/apps?p=6">6</a><span aria-hidden="true">…</span><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=12" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=12" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="12" href="/apps?p=12">12</a><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=6" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=6" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="6" href="/apps?p=6">&lt;Next&gt;</a></div></nav>

=== Pagination / at the first page ===
Previous stays visible and named with no href — removing it moves every other control one place left — and a disabled end carries no island contract, because a control that goes nowhere fires nothing
<nav aria-label="Application pages, first"><div><a aria-disabled="true" tabindex="-1">&lt;Previous&gt;</a><a aria-current="page" data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=1" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=1" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="1" href="/apps?p=1">1</a><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=2" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=2" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="2" href="/apps?p=2">2</a><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=3" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=3" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="3" href="/apps?p=3">3</a><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?p=2" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?p=2" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-page="2" href="/apps?p=2">&lt;Next&gt;</a></div></nav>

=== PaneHost / a primary pane alone ===
the host is the primary pane's frame; with no side panes there is nothing to open and no script needed
<div data-hui-panehost="" id=""><div data-hui-pane="primary">Customers</div></div>

=== PaneHost / a secondary pane, open, with a deep link ===
the open state ships in the markup so first paint matches the server, and the deep-link parameter names the query key the runtime records the open pane in
<div data-hui-pane-deeplink="pane" data-hui-pane-open="secondary" data-hui-panehost="" id=""><div data-hui-pane="primary">Customers</div><div aria-label="Details" data-hui-pane="secondary" role="region">Ticket detail</div></div>

=== PaneHost / an outside trigger addressing its host by id ===
a trigger beyond every host (a toolbar above the panes) drives the host its data-hui-pane-host-target names — the control attribute beside it is the same one an in-host trigger carries
<div data-hui-panehost="" id="host"><div data-hui-pane="primary">Customers</div><div aria-label="Secondary" data-hui-pane="secondary" hidden="" role="region">Ticket detail</div></div><button data-hui-pane-host-target="host" data-hui-pane-open-control="secondary" type="button">Ticket detail</button>

=== Password / revealable ===
the reveal button says what it will do next rather than what the field is doing now, and the labels it swaps between are published for the runtime instead of built from a class
<div><label for="password-token">Registry token</label><div data-hui-affix=""><input data-hui-affix-input="" id="password-token" name="token" type="password"><button aria-label="&lt;ShowPassword&gt;" aria-pressed="false" data-hui-hide-label="&lt;HidePassword&gt;" data-hui-hide-text="&lt;RevealHide&gt;" data-hui-reveal="" data-hui-show-label="&lt;ShowPassword&gt;" data-hui-show-text="&lt;RevealShow&gt;" type="button">&lt;RevealShow&gt;</button></div></div>

=== Rail / an observed rail ===
every entry is a real fragment link before any script runs, and the observer is armed by the module the root hook loads
<aside aria-label="By intent" data-hui-rail="" data-hui-rail-observe="#sections" data-hui-rail-target="section[id]"><div>By intent</div><ol><li><a href="#modeling"><span>01</span>Modeling<span>9</span></a></li><li><a href="#serving"><span>02</span>Serving<span>9</span></a></li></ol></aside>

=== Rail / a static rail ===
with no observation selector the links still work and nothing is marked — the active state is enhancement, never the only state
<aside aria-label="Sections"><div>Sections</div><ol><li><a href="#one">One</a></li></ol></aside>

=== Rail / a bare entry ===
the eyebrow and the count are optional, so the same list serves the plain and the annotated rail without a second anatomy
<aside aria-label="Steps"><div>Steps</div><ol><li><a href="#install">Install</a></li><li><a href="#run">Run</a></li></ol></aside>

=== RangeSlider / a full default pair ===
two named range inputs the form submits as -min and -max, each thumb named (Minimum/Maximum) because two anonymous thumbs in one group tell a screen reader user nothing
<div aria-label="Price" data-hui-range-slider="" role="group"><span>Price</span><output data-hui-range-slider-output="&lt;RangeValue %s %s&gt;" for="price-min price-max">&lt;RangeValue 0 100&gt;</output><div><input aria-label="&lt;RangeLow Price&gt;" data-hui-range-slider-low="" id="price-min" max="100" min="0" name="price-min" step="1" type="range" value="0"><input aria-label="&lt;RangeHigh Price&gt;" data-hui-range-slider-high="" id="price-max" max="100" min="0" name="price-max" step="1" type="range" value="100"></div></div>

=== RangeSlider / a narrowed pair ===
the output sentence travels with the output (the module re-formats through it, so a translated page says its own words live) and a crossed pair renders ordered — the same repair the module makes of a drag
<div aria-label="Age" data-hui-range-slider="" role="group"><span>Age</span><output data-hui-range-slider-output="&lt;RangeValue %s %s&gt;" for="age-min age-max">&lt;RangeValue 25 40&gt;</output><div><input aria-label="&lt;RangeLow Age&gt;" data-hui-range-slider-low="" id="age-min" max="65" min="18" name="age-min" step="1" type="range" value="25"><input aria-label="&lt;RangeHigh Age&gt;" data-hui-range-slider-high="" id="age-max" max="65" min="18" name="age-max" step="1" type="range" value="40"></div></div>

=== RangeSlider / equal values ===
low equal to high is a real pair — a single-point range, rendered as given rather than repaired
<div aria-label="Window" data-hui-range-slider="" role="group"><span>Window</span><div><input aria-label="&lt;RangeLow Window&gt;" data-hui-range-slider-low="" id="window-min" max="100" min="0" name="window-min" step="1" type="range" value="5"><input aria-label="&lt;RangeHigh Window&gt;" data-hui-range-slider-high="" id="window-max" max="100" min="0" name="window-max" step="1" type="range" value="5"></div></div>

=== Rating / no selection ===
zero is a real value — no rating chosen — and the radios still submit nothing rather than a pretend zero
<fieldset aria-label="Score" role="radiogroup"><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 5 5&gt;" id="score-5" name="score" type="radio" value="5"><label for="score-5"><span aria-hidden="true">★</span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 4 5&gt;" id="score-4" name="score" type="radio" value="4"><label for="score-4"><span aria-hidden="true">★</span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 3 5&gt;" id="score-3" name="score" type="radio" value="3"><label for="score-3"><span aria-hidden="true">★</span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 2 5&gt;" id="score-2" name="score" type="radio" value="2"><label for="score-2"><span aria-hidden="true">★</span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 1 5&gt;" id="score-1" name="score" type="radio" value="1"><label for="score-1"><span aria-hidden="true">★</span></label></fieldset>

=== Rating / a middle choice ===
each radio says its own name ("3 out of 5") and the checked one is the group's value the form POSTs — the whole contract, with no module at all
<fieldset aria-label="Score" role="radiogroup"><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 5 5&gt;" id="score-5" name="score" type="radio" value="5"><label for="score-5"><span aria-hidden="true">★</span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 4 5&gt;" id="score-4" name="score" type="radio" value="4"><label for="score-4"><span aria-hidden="true">★</span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 3 5&gt;" checked="" id="score-3" name="score" type="radio" value="3"><label for="score-3"><span aria-hidden="true">★</span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 2 5&gt;" id="score-2" name="score" type="radio" value="2"><label for="score-2"><span aria-hidden="true">★</span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 1 5&gt;" id="score-1" name="score" type="radio" value="1"><label for="score-1"><span aria-hidden="true">★</span></label></fieldset>

=== Rating / a caller's glyph, disabled ===
the glyph is presentation, hidden from assistive technology and swappable, and disabled takes the group out without unravelling the names
<fieldset aria-label="Heat" role="radiogroup"><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 5 5&gt;" disabled="" id="heat-5" name="heat" type="radio" value="5"><label for="heat-5"><span aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2z"/></svg></span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 4 5&gt;" disabled="" id="heat-4" name="heat" type="radio" value="4"><label for="heat-4"><span aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2z"/></svg></span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 3 5&gt;" disabled="" id="heat-3" name="heat" type="radio" value="3"><label for="heat-3"><span aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2z"/></svg></span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 2 5&gt;" checked="" disabled="" id="heat-2" name="heat" type="radio" value="2"><label for="heat-2"><span aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2z"/></svg></span></label><input aria-label="&lt;RatingChoice 1 5&gt;" disabled="" id="heat-1" name="heat" type="radio" value="1"><label for="heat-1"><span aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2z"/></svg></span></label></fieldset>

=== Repeater / named submit controls, no script ===
the add and remove controls are named submit buttons riding the surrounding form — the no-script page adds and removes rows through ordinary POSTs, and each remove names its row
<div aria-label="Links" data-hui-repeater="links" role="group"><span>Links</span><ul aria-label="Links" id="links-items" role="list"><li data-hui-repeater-index="0" data-hui-repeater-item=""><div><input aria-label="Link label" name="links-label" type="text"></div><div><button aria-label="&lt;RepeaterRemove 1&gt;" data-hui-repeater-action="remove" name="links_remove" type="submit" value="0">&lt;RepeaterRemove 1&gt;</button></div></li><li data-hui-repeater-index="1" data-hui-repeater-item=""><div><input aria-label="Link label" name="links-label" type="text"></div><div><button aria-label="&lt;RepeaterRemove 2&gt;" data-hui-repeater-action="remove" name="links_remove" type="submit" value="1">&lt;RepeaterRemove 2&gt;</button></div></li></ul><button data-hui-repeater-action="add" name="links_add" type="submit" value="1">&lt;RepeaterAdd&gt;</button><span data-hui-repeater-status="" role="status"></span></div>

=== Repeater / an island repeater ===
the same buttons carry the framework's RPC contract beside their submit semantics — the href-shaped operation in the endpoint's query — so the region swaps in place and the module restores focus to the row or the add control
<div aria-label="Guests" data-hui-repeater="guests" role="group"><span>Guests</span><ul aria-label="Guests" id="guests-items" role="list"><li data-hui-repeater-index="0" data-hui-repeater-item=""><div><input aria-label="Link label" name="links-label" type="text"></div><div><button aria-label="&lt;RepeaterRemove 1&gt;" data-fui-rpc="/island/guests?index=0&amp;op=remove" data-fui-rpc-method="POST" data-fui-rpc-signal="guests" data-hui-repeater-action="remove" type="submit">&lt;RepeaterRemove 1&gt;</button></div></li></ul><button data-fui-rpc="/island/guests?op=add" data-fui-rpc-method="POST" data-fui-rpc-signal="guests" data-hui-repeater-action="add" type="submit">&lt;RepeaterAdd&gt;</button><span data-hui-repeater-status="" role="status"></span></div>

=== Repeater / at the floor ===
a min of one disables the single row's remove control rather than hiding it — the row is real, and the control says it cannot go
<div aria-label="Owners" data-hui-repeater="owners" role="group"><span>Owners</span><ul aria-label="Owners" id="owners-items" role="list"><li data-hui-repeater-index="0" data-hui-repeater-item=""><div><input aria-label="Link label" name="links-label" type="text"></div><div><button aria-label="&lt;RepeaterRemove 1&gt;" data-hui-repeater-action="remove" disabled="" name="owners_remove" type="submit" value="0">&lt;RepeaterRemove 1&gt;</button></div></li></ul><button data-hui-repeater-action="add" name="owners_add" type="submit" value="1">&lt;RepeaterAdd&gt;</button><span data-hui-repeater-status="" role="status">One owner is required.</span></div>

=== Section / named ===
a name is what makes it a landmark, and the name comes from the heading itself rather than a second string that can drift from it
<section aria-labelledby="section-volumes-title"><div><div><h2 id="section-volumes-title">Volumes</h2><p>Disks attached to this node.</p></div><div><button type="button">Add</button></div></div><div><p>Two volumes.</p></div></section>

=== Section / an eyebrow ===
the kicker above the title is hidden from the tree: it decorates a heading the reader has already heard, and reading the section's name twice is the alternative
<section aria-labelledby="section-the-cluster-title"><div><p aria-hidden="true">01 / Overview</p><h2 id="section-the-cluster-title">The cluster</h2></div><div><p>One leader, two workers.</p></div></section>

=== Section / named without a heading ===
a name is what makes it a landmark, and a label the page already carries can name a region whose heading lives somewhere else
<section aria-label="Settings"><div><p>Loose but named.</p></div></section>

=== Section / unnamed ===
no title and no label means a plain div: a section with no name is a row in the landmark list that says nothing, which is worse than not being in it
<div><div><p>Loose content.</p></div></div>

=== Section / deeper in the outline ===
the level is the caller's decision — a section under an h2 that renders an h2 leaves a hole a screen reader user has to guess at
<section aria-labelledby="section-mounts-title"><div><h3 id="section-mounts-title">Mounts</h3></div><div><p>One.</p></div></section>

=== Select / options ===
a real select, because the platform's own picker is the one thing that already works on a phone, with a keyboard, and under every screen reader
<select id="region" name="region"><option value="us-east">US East</option><option selected="" value="eu-west">EU West</option></select>

=== Sidebar / a persistent sidebar ===
every leaf is a real link and every group a native details, so the whole navigation works with no script
<nav aria-label="Primary" data-hui-sidebar="" data-hui-sidebar-variant="persistent"><div>Workspace</div><ul><li><a aria-current="page" href="/"><span>Home</span></a></li><li><details data-hui-sidebar-group=""><summary><span>Settings</span></summary><ul><li><a href="/settings/profile"><span>Profile</span></a></li><li><a href="/settings/team"><span>Team</span></a></li></ul></details></li></ul></nav>

=== Sidebar / collapsible with storage ===
the collapse state is opt-in to storage through the key — without one the state is the server's, and the module never writes
<nav aria-label="Primary" data-hui-sidebar="" data-hui-sidebar-collapse="auto" data-hui-sidebar-storage="nav.side" data-hui-sidebar-variant="collapsible"><button aria-label="Primary" data-fui-open="nav-drawer" data-hui-sidebar-toggle="" type="button">☰</button><ul><li><a href="/one"><span>One</span></a></li></ul></nav>

=== Skeleton / three lines ===
every bar is hidden from the tree: a screen reader reading out eight empty boxes, or announcing each shimmer, is strictly worse than one polite "Loading apps" and silence
<div data-hui-lines="3" role="status"><span aria-hidden="true"></span><span aria-hidden="true"></span><span aria-hidden="true" data-hui-skeleton-last=""></span><span>Loading apps</span></div>

=== Slider / with a live output ===
the output is a real form output associated with the input, its SSR text is the true value, and the hook it carries is how the module keeps it in step while the thumb moves
<div data-hui-slider=""><label for="cpu">CPU share</label><output data-hui-slider-output="" for="cpu">40</output><input aria-label="CPU share" id="cpu" max="100" min="0" name="cpu" step="1" type="range" value="40"><div><span>0</span><span>100</span></div></div>

=== Slider / bare, no output ===
a slider with no output renders no hook at all — markup carried for no one is the defect the hooks gate exists to catch
<div data-hui-slider=""><label for="mem">Memory</label><input aria-label="Memory" id="mem" max="100" min="0" name="mem" step="1" type="range" value="0"></div>

=== Slider / bounded custom step ===
a step the value lands on: the browser, the server and the module all read the same three attributes, and a value between steps renders as given — data, not a broken prop
<div data-hui-slider=""><label for="batch">Batch size</label><output data-hui-slider-output="" for="batch">50</output><input aria-label="Batch size" id="batch" max="100" min="10" name="batch" step="10" type="range" value="50"></div>

=== Spacer / plain ===
it renders nothing, says nothing, and is in the markup only because a row needs a thing to grow — the space between two controls is the skin's, not a third control somebody wedged between them
<div><button type="button">Save</button><span aria-hidden="true" data-hui-grow="1"></span><button type="button">Delete app</button></div>

=== Spacer / bounded ===
a floor and a ceiling are names from the gap scale, so a spacer that must stay legible at any width says so in the same vocabulary every other gap uses
<div>Queued builds<span aria-hidden="true" data-hui-grow="2"></span>2</div>

=== Spacer / leader in a contents list ===
the dotted line between a term and its value is what ties the pair together once the row is wider than they are — and the spacer is a span so the list can be one paragraph, which a div would silently split
<p>Restarts<span aria-hidden="true" data-hui-grow="1"></span>263</p>

=== Spacer / rule ===
a hairline across the space reads as structure rather than as a tie, and the two are one knob each: a line that must be both is a line nobody chose
<p>Deploys today<span aria-hidden="true" data-hui-grow="1"></span>8</p>

=== Spinner / inline wait ===
role=status, not progressbar: a progressbar promises a value and a spinner has none — and the label says what is being waited for, because a moving shape says nothing on its own
<span><span aria-hidden="true"></span><span>Checking the registry</span></span>

=== Spinner / dots ===
the shape is the class map's choice and the meaning never moves: the dots are hidden and the label is what the wait is for
<span><span aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span></span><span>Saving</span></span>

=== Spinner / grid ===
a heavy wait says so with a busier picture, and the picture is still hidden: the nine cells are motion and the label is the meaning
<span><span aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></span><span>Restoring the backup</span></span>

=== Stack / default gap ===
no gap named is still a gap: the default is this primitive's own rhythm, so two pages that say nothing agree
<div><p>CPU is back under 60%.</p><p>The worker drained its deploy queue overnight.</p></div>

=== Stack / named gap ===
the step is a name from the scale, never a length the caller brings — the class either exists in the skin or the value is a typo, and both show the first time anyone looks
<div><p>Queued builds: 0.</p><p>Running builds: 2.</p></div>

=== Stack / one child ===
a stack of one is still a stack: the element is the seam the second block arrives into, and a wrapper that appears with it moves everything below
<div><p>No volumes are attached to this node.</p></div>

=== StatCard / with a trend ===
label before value, and the trend's direction carried by its own words — the colour the class map paints from Direction is emphasis, never the only carrier
<div><p>Active users</p><p>12,483</p><p data-direction="up">+12% vs. last week</p></div>

=== StatCard / the number alone ===
a card with no trend renders without one, and the label still arrives before the value it names
<div><p>Queued builds</p><p>2</p></div>

=== StepWizard / the first step ===
the transition is a plain form POST with wizard_action=next — the no-script page walks the whole flow — and the first step renders no Back because there is nothing to go back to
<form action="/setup" data-hui-step-wizard="" data-hui-step-wizard-current="0" method="POST"><ol aria-label="&lt;StepOf 1 3&gt;"><li aria-current="step" data-state="current"><span aria-label="&lt;StepName 1 Source&gt;"><span aria-hidden="true">1</span><span>Source</span></span></li><li data-state="todo"><span aria-label="&lt;StepName 2 Build&gt;"><span aria-hidden="true">2</span><span>Build</span></span></li><li data-state="todo"><span aria-label="&lt;StepName 3 Deploy&gt;"><span aria-hidden="true">3</span><span>Deploy</span></span></li></ol><h2 tabindex="-1">Source</h2><div><input aria-label="Repository" name="repo" type="text"></div><div><button data-hui-step-wizard-action="next" name="wizard_action" type="submit" value="next">&lt;StepNext&gt;</button></div><span data-hui-step-wizard-status="" role="status">&lt;StepOf 1 3&gt;</span></form>

=== StepWizard / mid-flow, with Back ===
the rail names every dot (the step and its heading) and says where the reader is (step of total), the current dot carries aria-current, and Back submits the same form with the other value
<form action="/setup" data-hui-step-wizard="" data-hui-step-wizard-current="1" method="POST"><ol aria-label="&lt;StepOf 2 3&gt;"><li data-state="done"><span aria-label="&lt;StepName 1 Source&gt;"><span aria-hidden="true">✓</span><span>Source</span></span></li><li aria-current="step" data-state="current"><span aria-label="&lt;StepName 2 Build&gt;"><span aria-hidden="true">2</span><span>Build</span></span></li><li data-state="todo"><span aria-label="&lt;StepName 3 Deploy&gt;"><span aria-hidden="true">3</span><span>Deploy</span></span></li></ol><h2 tabindex="-1">Build</h2><p>About a minute</p><div><button data-hui-step-wizard-action="back" name="wizard_action" type="submit" value="back">&lt;StepBack&gt;</button><button data-hui-step-wizard-action="next" name="wizard_action" type="submit" value="next">&lt;StepNext&gt;</button></div><span data-hui-step-wizard-status="" role="status">&lt;StepOf 2 3&gt;</span></form>

=== StepWizard / the last step, an island, a failed submit ===
the last step's weighted action says Submit, the failed submit's summary rides the form the existing headless module already focuses, and the Island makes the answer a region update the wizard module announces through the server's step-of sentence
<form action="/setup" data-fui-rpc="/island/setup" data-fui-rpc-method="POST" data-fui-rpc-signal="setup" data-hui-form-errors="" data-hui-step-wizard="" data-hui-step-wizard-current="2" id="setup" method="POST"><ol aria-label="&lt;StepOf 3 3&gt;"><li data-state="done"><span aria-label="&lt;StepName 1 Source&gt;"><span aria-hidden="true">✓</span><span>Source</span></span></li><li data-state="done"><span aria-label="&lt;StepName 2 Build&gt;"><span aria-hidden="true">✓</span><span>Build</span></span></li><li aria-current="step" data-state="current"><span aria-label="&lt;StepName 3 Deploy&gt;"><span aria-hidden="true">3</span><span>Deploy</span></span></li></ol><div aria-labelledby="setup-errors-title" id="setup-errors" role="alert" tabindex="-1"><h2 id="setup-errors-title">&lt;ThereIsAProblem&gt;</h2><ul><li>Pick a region</li></ul></div><h2 tabindex="-1">Deploy</h2><div><button data-hui-step-wizard-action="back" name="wizard_action" type="submit" value="back">&lt;StepBack&gt;</button><button data-hui-step-wizard-action="next" name="wizard_action" type="submit" value="next">&lt;StepSubmit&gt;</button></div><span data-hui-step-wizard-status="" role="status">&lt;StepOf 3 3&gt;</span></form>

=== Steps / part way ===
a rail of states, not a set of controls: each step's data-state drives both its marker and the line drawn between markers, so the picture cannot disagree with the states
<ol><li data-state="done"><span><span aria-hidden="true">✓</span><span><span>Source</span></span></span></li><li aria-current="step" data-state="current"><span><span aria-hidden="true">2</span><span><span>Build</span><span>About a minute</span></span></span></li><li data-state="todo"><span><span aria-hidden="true">3</span><span><span>Deploy</span></span></span></li></ol>

=== Steps / not started ===
zero is a real value — nothing has begun — and is not the same as being on the first step
<ol><li data-state="todo"><span><span aria-hidden="true">1</span><span><span>Source</span></span></span></li><li data-state="todo"><span><span aria-hidden="true">2</span><span><span>Build</span></span></span></li><li data-state="todo"><span><span aria-hidden="true">3</span><span><span>Deploy</span></span></span></li></ol>

=== Steps / a completed step links back ===
a step that is done is somewhere the reader may want to return to, and the link keeps its href for a reader with no script
<ol><li data-state="done"><a href="/setup/source"><span aria-hidden="true">01</span><span><span>Source</span></span></a></li><li aria-current="step" data-state="current"><span><span aria-hidden="true">02</span><span><span>Build</span></span></span></li></ol>

=== Switch / on ===
a checkbox that says role=switch: it submits like a checkbox and is announced as on or off rather than checked or unchecked
<label><input checked="" name="auto" role="switch" type="checkbox"><span>Restart automatically</span></label>

=== SystemBanner / deploy in progress ===
a message about the system, shown by the server's own render: role=status so it waits its turn, one action, and the tone said in words as well as drawn in colour
<div data-hui-system="" data-hui-system-id="sys-deploy" role="status"><span aria-hidden="true"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25"/><path d="M5.5 8.25 7.25 10l3.25-3.5"/></svg></span><p><span>&lt;ToneInfo&gt;: </span>Deploy in progress</p><p>blog is moving to image 41; the app stays reachable the whole time.</p><div><button type="button">View the deploy</button></div><button aria-label="&lt;DismissTitled Deploy in progress&gt;" data-hui-system-dismiss="" type="button">×</button></div>

=== SystemBanner / offline ===
the built-in connection message, and the one system banner worth interrupting for: assertive, marked as the runtime's, shipped hidden because the runtime — not the page — shows it, and carrying no dismiss because its ending is the reconnect
<div aria-live="assertive" data-hui-system="" data-hui-system-id="sys-offline" data-hui-system-offline="" hidden="" role="alert"><p><span>&lt;ToneWarning&gt;: </span>Connection lost</p><p>Changes are paused until the connection comes back.</p></div>

=== SystemBanner / new version ===
a dismissable message the page did not show: it ships hidden for an island swap or the runtime to reveal, and the id is what keeps it from being shown twice
<div data-hui-system="" data-hui-system-id="sys-version" hidden="" role="status"><p><span>&lt;ToneSuccess&gt;: </span>A new version is ready</p><p>Reload to pick up version 0.4.2.</p><button aria-label="&lt;DismissTitled A new version is ready&gt;" data-hui-system-dismiss="" type="button">×</button></div>

=== SystemBanner / maintenance, and the version is old ===
the danger tone said as a word before the title, and two banners at once to prove the ids keep them from doubling up
<div data-hui-system="" data-hui-system-id="sys-maint" role="status"><p><span>&lt;ToneDanger&gt;: </span>Ending in 4 minutes</p><p>This control plane restarts at 20:00 UTC.</p><button aria-label="&lt;DismissTitled Ending in 4 minutes&gt;" data-hui-system-dismiss="" type="button">×</button></div><div data-hui-system="" data-hui-system-id="sys-old" hidden="" role="status"><p><span>&lt;ToneInfo&gt;: </span>This browser is not supported</p><button aria-label="&lt;DismissTitled This browser is not supported&gt;" data-hui-system-dismiss="" type="button">×</button></div>

=== Table / sorted, carrying a query, one header-less sortable column ===
aria-sort on the active column and none on the rest, the href's sort and dir replaced rather than appended so the query the screen carries survives a sort, and the header-less column's anchor named from Strings — an anchor with no text is a control with no name
<div data-hui-table="" data-hui-table-announcement="&lt;TableSortedBy Name &lt;SortAscending&gt;&gt;"><div aria-labelledby="table-applications-caption" data-hui-table-scroll="" role="region" tabindex="0"><table role="table"><caption id="table-applications-caption">Applications</caption><thead role="rowgroup"><tr role="row"><th aria-sort="ascending" role="columnheader" scope="col"><a href="/apps?dir=desc&amp;page=3&amp;q=blog&amp;sort=name">Name</a></th><th aria-sort="none" role="columnheader" scope="col"><a aria-label="&lt;TableSortBy env&gt;" href="/apps?dir=asc&amp;page=3&amp;q=blog&amp;sort=env"></a></th><th role="columnheader" scope="col">Region</th></tr></thead><tbody role="rowgroup"><tr id="app-1" role="row"><td data-label="Name" role="cell">blog</td><td role="cell">production</td><td data-label="Region" role="cell">eu-1</td></tr><tr id="app-2" role="row"><td data-label="Name" role="cell">shop</td><td role="cell">staging</td><td data-label="Region" role="cell">us-1</td></tr></tbody></table></div><span data-hui-table-status="" role="status"></span></div>

=== Table / the same table as an island ===
an embedded table's sort anchors carry the RPC contract beside their hrefs — the page without script, the region update with it, the query shared so the two answer one question — and the endpoint that carries its own query joins rather than stacks a second one; the announcement carries the sort sentence with the caller's Summary appended, for the module to copy into the status after the swap
<div data-hui-table="" data-hui-table-announcement="&lt;TableSortedBy Environment &lt;SortDescending&gt;&gt; Showing 1 of 8" data-hui-table-signal="apps"><div data-hui-table-scroll="" role="region" tabindex="0"><table role="table"><thead role="rowgroup"><tr role="row"><th aria-sort="none" role="columnheader" scope="col"><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?dir=asc&amp;q=blog&amp;sort=name" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?dir=asc&amp;keep=1&amp;q=blog&amp;sort=name" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-table-sort="name" href="/apps?dir=asc&amp;q=blog&amp;sort=name">Name</a></th><th aria-sort="descending" role="columnheader" scope="col"><a data-fui-push-state="/apps?dir=asc&amp;q=blog&amp;sort=env" data-fui-rpc="/island/apps?dir=asc&amp;keep=1&amp;q=blog&amp;sort=env" data-fui-rpc-method="GET" data-fui-rpc-signal="apps" data-hui-table-sort="env" href="/apps?dir=asc&amp;q=blog&amp;sort=env">Environment</a></th></tr></thead><tbody role="rowgroup"><tr id="app-1" role="row"><td data-label="Name" role="cell">blog</td><td data-label="Environment" role="cell">production</td></tr></tbody></table></div><span data-hui-table-status="" role="status"></span></div>

=== Table / empty with a slot ===
an empty result still has named columns and usable sort controls — the head stays — and the one cell that spans them says what the caller means by nothing here, in the caller's words
<div data-hui-table=""><div aria-labelledby="table-applications-caption" data-hui-table-scroll="" role="region" tabindex="0"><table role="table"><caption id="table-applications-caption">Applications</caption><thead role="rowgroup"><tr role="row"><th aria-sort="none" role="columnheader" scope="col"><a href="/apps?dir=asc&amp;sort=name">Name</a></th><th role="columnheader" scope="col">Environment</th></tr></thead><tbody role="rowgroup"><tr role="row"><td colspan="2" role="cell"><p>No applications match.</p></td></tr></tbody></table></div><span data-hui-table-status="" role="status"></span></div>

=== Table / with a footer ===
the footer renders as the scroll region's sibling, not inside the table, so a pager's nav landmark never nests in one — and the region is on the page with and without it, focusable either way
